description: Remove EXIF and GPS metadata from photos before sharing. Photo Metadata Remover opens a private cleaner inside ChatGPT for JPEG, PNG, and WebP images. Inspect hidden location, camera, date, XMP, IPTC, and related fields, then download a separate cleaned copy. Processing stays in the widget; KamnevApps does not receive the selected photo or cleaned output.

defaultPrompt: Remove EXIF and GPS location from this photo before I share it.
